skill.summary: Curate and send twice-daily English Telegram news updates featuring top 10 vetted stories on FX/CFD, crypto, trading tech, finance, and global politics.

latestVersion.changelog:
news-telegram-push v2.0.4

- Tightened and clarified output formatting: each headline must now be on the same line as its number, with the "Read more" link indented on the line below.
- Added explicit prohibition of summaries, commentary, and source labels in all sections.
- Updated the required numbering and indentation style for news items for greater clarity and Telegram compatibility.
- Minor editorial refinements to documentation for consistency and precision.
